description: Go-produced vectors (pkg/rules MemberCall, pkg/evm/stawi) for StawiAccount.executeEngineCall: calldata is the member action's exact static ABI encoding; call_hash = keccak256(abi.encode(address target, bytes calldata)) is the ENGINE_CALL intent's authorization_id; committed is the intent amount (the call's value word: a pledge, a payoff ceiling, an offer's, payment's or move's amount, an ask's or acceptance's max_repay; else 0); digest is the intent digest (pkg/intent ENCODING.md) the device signs. target_name is rules_engine, loan_book or vault; path room runs under destination ROOM_CUSTODY = the call's first argument (room), path personal under destination PERSONAL_VAULT = vault with no room, and names the counterparty the account checks (zero when the action names none).
